# 21risk

21RISK is a web application that simplifies working with checklists, audits, and actions, facilitating compliance and risk management processes.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/21risk/.

## Actions

- **Get Items (BETA)** (read-only): Retrieve items (beta) from the 21risk odata api.
- **Get Organizations** (read-only): Retrieve organizations from the 21risk odata api.
- **Get Reports** (read-only): Retrieve audit reports, including draft, published, and scheduled reports.
- **Get Risk Models** (read-only): Retrieve risk models used for audits and compliance.
- **Get RiskModel Categories** (read-only): Retrieve risk model categories for grouping questions and compliance checks.
- **Get Sites** (read-only): Retrieve sites (locations) from the 21risk odata api.
- **Get Compliance** (read-only): Retrieve compliance data for sites, categories, or questions.
- **Get Items Per Month** (read-only): Retrieve fact table data for itemspermonth, one row per question per site per month.
- **Get Properties** (read-only): Fetch a list of properties related to sites, including cope information and other relevant data.
